params.name: id

params.name: filters
params.description:
JSON specifying filter conditions.

Accepts the same format and filters as returned by the [sprints](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/sprints/) endpoint.

items.docs: List sprints in the project. The sprints might be ones native to the project or shared with it. This endpoint supports pagination and filtering.

params.name: filters
params.description:
JSON specifying filter conditions.
Accepts the same format as returned by the [queries](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/queries/) endpoint.
Currently supported filters are:

+ definingWorkspace: filters sprints based on the project they are defined in. This is opposed to the projects they are shared with.

params.name: offset
params.description: Page number inside the requested collection.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of elements to display per page.

items.docs: List sprints visible to the user. This endpoint supports pagination and filtering.
Retrieves a sprint defined by its unique identifier.
